description: Given what you want (safe and failure-free / fast / strong under load / good surface / economical), returns ordered parameter adjustments grouped by what they counter: adhesion and warping, nozzle collisions, surface quality, structural strength, time, filament. Each move includes its mechanism, a suggested value, its cost, and **the actual value in the current preset and its shape** (per-extruder parameters must be overridden with an array; a scalar is silently not applied). If modelPath is given, a printability analysis runs first and conditional adjustments are added based on the geometry. This is for planning before a print; to work back from a print that already failed, use bambu_diagnose. It only returns a plan and changes nothing. No side effects.

goal.description: What you want, in natural language, e.g. "don't let it fail, print slowly at high quality" or "in a hurry". Chinese goals are matched too.

goalId.description: Specify the goal directly; skips text matching.

material.description: PLA / PETG / ABS / ASA / TPU; a material-specific note is returned when one exists.

modelPath.description: If a model is given, a printability analysis runs first and conditional adjustments are added based on the geometry (e.g. a wider brim when the base area is too small).

processPreset.description: Defaults to the preset currently selected in Bambu Studio.

name: bambu_plan_settings

currentValue.description: The value in the current preset.

triggeredBy.description: Which printability finding triggered this move; empty means it is a base adjustment for the goal.

valueShape.description: Per-extruder parameters must be overridden with an array; a scalar is silently not applied.

title: Plan settings for a goal
